note: SFMTA inventory sign plates (eo-props Model::SignPlate faces) modelled in Blender from the official sign art; nothing imported, generated or traced. Frame: glTF Y up, the face toward +Z, the post axis at x = z = 0, the plate frame (the face's most common inventory plate size, frameM) from y = 0 to y = frameM[1]; the art fitted into it uniformly (fit) and centred, as the game's sign atlas fits it. One material on one atlas: the face above a strip of metal swatches (aluminium back, stainless bolts and bands, cast saddles, nylon washers); albedo 512 px, ORM (R 1, G roughness, B metal) and normal 256 px, JPEG. lods: the plates with their hardware; the plates; the plates' outlines simplified, unchamfered. variants: the same face worn otherwise (rusty: rust bled from the steel bolts, bands and saddles, edges corroded; battered: a corner creased, the plate knocked crooked on its pole, sheeting peeled to the aluminium, dents, marker scribbles), each with its own first two levels and the aged far level.
sheetSource: modelling value: common 0.080 in aluminium blank; no primary source read in this pass
